info.title: AMARACUS Cryptographic Developer Platform API
info.description: Production-grade cryptographic API providing unified access to Classical Cryptography, Post-Quantum Cryptography (ML-KEM, ML-DSA), Key Management (KMS & BYOK), PKI & Certificates, Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), and Advanced Cryptography (ZK, FHE, MPC, Threshold Cryptography).

ApiKeyAuth.description: Authenticate using an AMARACUS API Key. Provide the key in the Authorization header: `Bearer am_live_...` or `Bearer am_test_...`.

code.description: Standardized error code from the AMARACUS Error Catalog.

message.example: API credential lacks required scope crypto:execute.

details.description: Additional structured error context if available.

requestId.description: Unique correlation ID for tracing the request.

get.description: Public discovery endpoint returning supported cryptographic operations, algorithms, standards, and security features without requiring authentication.
Retrieves the complete catalog of supported classical, post-quantum, and hybrid algorithms from the central AMARACUS registry.

post.description: Encrypts plaintext using authenticated AEAD encryption (AES-256-GCM) with a logical key ID or raw key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key to ensure idempotent replay-safe execution.

rawKey.description: Raw 256-bit symmetric key in hex or base64 format.

data.description: Plaintext string or binary payload to encrypt.

post.description: Decrypts an authenticated ciphertext envelope and cryptographically verifies authenticity tag.

400.description: Authentication tag mismatch or invalid payload

post.description: Calculates FIPS-compliant cryptographic digests using SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, or SHA3.
Generates a digital signature using ED25519 or post-quantum signature schemes.
Verifies an asymmetric digital signature against a payload.

get.description: Inspects status, algorithm, duration, and metadata for an asynchronous or synchronous operation.
Retrieves sanitized key metadata by ID.

patch.description: Updates name, description, or enabled status for a logical key.

delete.description: Permanently marks key as DESTROYED and zeroes key material.

post.description: Generates a new key version and marks it active.

get.description: Retrieves health status of available KMS backend providers.
Returns health status and service metadata.
Inspects authenticated caller identity, organization context, granted scopes, or session details.
Retrieves all API credentials for the organization. Note that raw secret keys are never returned after creation.

post.description: Generates a new scoped API key. The raw API key (`am_live_...` or `am_test_...`) is returned ONCE in this response. Store it securely; AMARACUS only retains its SHA-256 hash.

201.description: API key successfully created. Contains one-time raw secret.

rawApiKey.description: Shown ONLY once at creation time.

post.description: Generates a new raw key secret for this credential and immediately invalidates the old secret.

200.description: Key successfully rotated. Contains new one-time raw secret.

post.description: Registers a webhook endpoint for cryptographic event notifications. Returns signing secret once.

201.description: Webhook created with one-time signing secret

post.description: Dispatches asynchronous execution of resource-intensive operations (ZK_PROVE, FHE_EVALUATE, MPC_COMPUTE, DISCOVERY_SCAN).

200.description: Job status and completed payload result

get.description: Returns list of FIPS-standardized PQC algorithms (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65).

post.description: Generates an authentic NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM) or FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) keypair.
Encapsulates a shared secret under a recipient ML-KEM public key.
Decapsulates the shared secret using the recipient ML-KEM private key.
